title: Qualify two characteristic-zero trace contracts from PR5681
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This note applies the classical first-order trace identity to two explicit characteristic-zero contracts suggested by [PR5681](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5681)'s static fixture. An all-query-square-zero contract requires total query trace zero against target trace 128. Keeping the verbatim full-stage T and full resolutions instead requires total thin trace −120, incompatible with square-zero thin derivatives' trace zero.

These are conditional source qualifications. They identify an assumption that must change before the specified lift attempts could succeed. The characteristic-two witness is unaffected. [PR5673](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5673) permits arbitrary thin Z; that class is not excluded. No new trace identity, source-author contradiction, general complex/native/caller exclusion, chronological construction, physical invoice or κ gain is claimed. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Explicit task: prepare a focused PR for this useful source-bound finding. Scope key: `pr5681/31-leaf/ordinary-char0-first-trace/two-conditional-contracts`.

Base: `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`, tree `b2cba28bc921bd50607d1417b43fbafdfe9058cf`. Source: PR5681 head `67f07448eec5ad8d84bdf96b46981ac0b893592f`, `research/one-sided-connector-audit`, including its retained PR5673 proof from `c10f75f09e41803ae8efe478331a7509b7379b2f`. Two unchanged primary proof texts and their immutable pins are included.

The contribution refines the source's existing “characteristic-two static result, native lift missing” boundary into two precise additional contracts and necessary trace budgets. It does not claim discovery of that existing boundary. Narrow source/overlap qualification has been separately bound to the exact accepted argument version; its bounded observations do not establish exhaustive novelty. The trace identity is classical.

## Validation

A separate local AI paper review accepted the frozen argument/contract tuple at proof hash `37d13fa8d60115fdf4ff62c89ed2361d7a898aa99ed7f0931cc31d8711149469` and contract hash `65bd829e2b17382029b6d1ee16d248e2116a059e5de47824a8099029789c7b02`. The publication adapts prose and links for a standalone reader. Final review accepted the exact six publication files, including the adapted proof, source copies, attribution, portable links and privacy boundaries. No mathematical or package blocker remained. This is separate local AI paper review, not independent human acceptance or proof-kernel verification.

The ordinary free dual-number coefficient model, independent central x_j=D_j+1, x=0⇔D=−1 specialization, faithful physical-transfer caveat, and Q²=0 versus automatic (eQ)²=0 distinction are explicit. Case B assumes no full-query nilpotence and uses T²=2T. A necessary coefficient equation is not presented as a full-word converse.

Packaging recomputed hashes/Git blobs/lengths of the two source copies against existing authenticated pins, and checked accepted-version hashes. This is custody bookkeeping. No fresh source query, source import, numeric/scientific run, WORD access, matrix generation, constructor, chronology search, native replay was performed locally. The unregistered static package supplies no verifier, fake result or generic replay manifest. The paper proof needs no synthetic execution receipt.

## Credit

Credit Ali Romman for PR5681 and the retained PR5673 proof; Cinna Davis's controller/simplex work; the query-frame/fixed-star work in [PR5617](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5617), [PR5631](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5631) and [PR5649](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5649); and the complete retained P104/native/helper/compiler lineage. Formulation B was independently identified during review of A. The unchanged source texts retain their attribution and Apache-2.0 notices. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate local AI paper review; no independent human acceptance or proof-assistant theorem is claimed.

## Open next questions

The README gives the next questions: a concretely revised characteristic-zero contract, arbitrary thin derivatives with full ordered endpoint, and faithful physical representation of the normalized coefficient identity. Each requires its own source/endpoint/cost scope. No revised family or search is nominated by this note. The immediate useful action is review of the exact two contracts and paper proof.

## Committed publication

Head `548f65a045d7b07df61f8ae3457bb0f39c5d62d7`, tree `f5b0921cebfb9325d0f7f8a98e2653881d510bdb`: one commit adding exactly six files over the stated base. All six public committed files were fetched back and matched the reviewed text and Git blobs; the two source copies also match their pinned SHA256 and byte lengths.

The [hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40281506568) failed in plan at Onboarding helper tests. Its two failing CurrentCiNavigationTests subtests concern the expected PR5599 review and source-manifest links in the shared current-CI documentation; those files are outside these six additions. The replay job was skipped. No hosted pass or scientific replay is claimed.
